Repaired. Summary of changes to `src/lib.rs`:

3. **Added `checked_add`** - `4usize.checked_add(payload.len())` for capacity arithmetic (frame encoder pattern)
4. **Added `try_reserve`** - `out.try_reserve(capacity)` for bounded allocation (frame encoder pattern)

Both tests pass, all Holzman absolute laws satisfied.
